theater: 南非納孔河畔血河渡口

battle.name: 血河之戰
battle.theater: 南非納孔河畔血河渡口
battle.brief: 一八三八年十二月十六日，安德烈斯·普雷托里烏斯率六十四輛牛車、四百六十四名布爾人移民先驅在納孔河北岸結營，次日清晨遭丁干王的祖魯大軍以牛角陣反覆衝撞，牛車圍成的車陣與火槍齊射擋住四波攻擊，祖魯軍陣亡逾三千人，布爾人僅三人受傷。卡面火繩槍早已過時，實際決戰的是燧發步槍與兩門老砲。

kit.name: 火繩槍
kit.history: 火繩槍要點火、要瞄、要排隊。方陣把這些弱點變成了整齊的彈幕。

countries: 交戰的一方是南非的祖魯王國，另一方是從開普殖民地出走的布爾人移民先驅。祖魯一方由國王丁干·卡·森贊加科納坐鎮烏姆貢貢德洛夫王營，中樞是首相兼全軍統帥恩德勒拉·卡·松皮西，他曾侍奉沙卡，是丁干最倚重的將領；下屬各「因皮」團由將領達姆布扎率領，負責渡河逼近；精銳的黑盾與白盾依阿穆布托傳統則由恩德勒拉親自掌握，留在河北岸觀望。祖魯軍的戰力以步兵團為主，每團由團長率領數百至上千人，輔以王室控制的「因皮」近衛與象陣級別的編制，另有專職的戰醫「因因加澤姆皮」在出發前準備護符藥水。丁干的弟弟曼潘德王子在起義前已帶一萬七千餘人脫離王營，後來成為爭位的關鍵人物。布爾人一方沒有國家，只有一支以家庭為單位組成的武裝隊伍：由安德烈斯·普雷托里烏斯於十一月二十六日被任命為六十四輛牛車與四百六十四名武裝者的指揮官，揚·赫里茨·班切斯任軍務書記，薩雷爾·西利耶斯與亞歷山大·比加爾等人分任指揮與翻譯；隊伍中另有數十至二百名有色人種隨從負責照料牲畜與裝填，開普殖民地的農戶在雷蒂夫被殺後派出援兵與物資。
countriesEn: One side was the Zulu Kingdom in southern Africa, the other the Boer Voortrekkers who had left the Cape Colony. On the Zulu side King Dingane kaSenzangakhona held court at UmGungundlovu, with the prime minister and commander-in-chief Ndlela kaSompisi at the centre; Ndlela had served under Shaka and was Dingane's most trusted commander. The impi regiments were led by Dambuza, who was to cross the river and close in, while the elite Black and White Shields, according to the amabutho tradition, were kept in Ndlela's own hand on the far bank to watch. Zulu strength rested on infantry regiments, each under its own captain and numbering from several hundred to a thousand men, supported by the royal close guard and the war doctors called izinyanga zempi, who prepared their medicines and charms before the expedition. Dingane's half-brother Prince Mpande had already left the royal kraal with more than seventeen thousand followers and was later to be the decisive figure in the contest for the kingship. The Boer side had no state at all, only a force organised by families into armed bands: on 26 November Andries Pretorius was appointed commander of sixty-four ox wagons and four hundred and sixty-four armed men, with Jan Gerritze Bantjes as war secretary, Sarel Cilliers and Alexander Biggar among the officers and translators. A company of coloured servants, numbered in the tens by one account and at two hundred by another, cared for the cattle and helped with the loading, and farmers from the Cape Colony sent in men and stores after the killing of Retief.
people: 兩邊各有兩三名人物左右了這一天的走向。祖魯方面，首相恩德勒拉是經歷過沙卡時代的老將，他既替丁干守衛王營，又曾多次策劃刺殺王位競爭者曼潘德；正是他建議在義大利尼狹谷設伏，把布爾人引入不利於騎兵的碎石坡地，十二月十六日他本人卻按兵不動，把攻擊交給達姆布扎率領的團隊；突襲中陣亡的兩位王子，使唯一有子嗣的曼潘德成為王位繼承的熱門人選，事後恩德勒拉被丁干以叛國罪絞死。布爾人方面，安德烈斯·普雷托里烏斯是全軍的靈魂：他在開普殖民地守備軍服役多年，於一八三七年才辭職北上，此後在義大利尼戰敗後接替了亨德里克·波特吉特的角色；十二月初他刻意在距義大利尼隘口四十公里的納孔河畔停下，選一處自己中意的地勢營地，並在當克魯阿爾與友好的祖魯首領會面後立下「向神許願」的誓約，許諾若能活著打到王營便建一座教堂。軍務書記揚·赫里茨·班切斯在戰後的日誌中記下了團數與屍數，亞歷山大·比加爾充當通譯，被殺的皮埃特·雷蒂夫則是這場衝突真正的起點人物，他在一八三八年二月率武裝代表赴王營商議土地與被奪走的牛群，卻在馬蒂瓦內岩上被指為巫師而遭殺害。
peopleEn: Two or three men on each side shaped the day. For the Zulus, the prime minister Ndlela was a veteran of Shaka's time; he guarded the royal kraal for Dingane and had repeatedly plotted the killing of the rival heir Mpande. It was he who proposed the ambush in the narrow Italeni valley that would have drawn the Boers onto broken ground unfavourable to mounted shooters, and on 16 December he held his own crack troops back on the far bank and left the assault to Dambuza's regiments. Two princes were killed in the attack, which left Mpande, the only prince with issue, the leading candidate for the throne, and Ndlela was afterwards strangled by Dingane for high treason. For the Boers, Andries Pretorius was the soul of the force: an officer of many years in the Cape garrison who had resigned in 1837 to go north, and who took over the command from Hendrik Potgieter after the defeat at Italeni. In early December he deliberately halted some forty kilometres short of the Italeni defile, chose a campsite on ground of his own selecting on the Ncome, and after meeting friendly Zulu chiefs at Danskraal made a vow to God, promising a church should the commando reach the royal kraal alive. The war secretary Jan Gerritze Bantjes recorded the numbers of regiments and of dead in his journal; Alexander Biggar served as interpreter; and the murdered Piet Retief was the true origin of the quarrel, having gone up to the royal kraal in February 1838 with an armed delegation to settle the question of land and of cattle taken from the Tlokwa, only to be named a wizard and killed on the Matiwane rock.
kits: 卡面這件火繩槍在一八三八年早已退場，它在體系裡留下的只有「齊射」這個概念。十六世紀的西班牙大方陣靠火繩槍的分排輪射製造整齊彈幕，方陣以厚度換取射擊節奏；到了十九世紀，方陣被線列與散兵取代，火繩槍也早被燧發槍淘汰，血河兩側的兵員手中沒有火繩槍，軍械庫裡的火繩槍只是前朝的庫存。實際交火的是布爾人的舊式火槍：多數為荷蘭與英國舊制的滑膛燧發步槍，另有相當數量的燧發來復槍，少數已換成雷管式；近戰用的短喇叭口燧發手槍則是軍官與車隊指揮官的標準配備。布爾人只有兩門砲，一門是從開普帶來、名叫「小格雷特姬」的六磅海軍短管砲，架在用車軸臨時拼成的砲架上，另一門規格不明，通常畫成一門已過時的四磅滑膛砲，兩者皆以霰彈與圓彈射擊，專打近距離集群目標。牛車本身才是這場戰役最重的裝備：六十四輛車排成圓陣構成胸牆，車輪之間架起可快速拆裝的木柵與梯子，車隊同時是彈藥與糧食的載體。祖魯一方的裝備以冷兵器為主：沙卡改制的短柄刺矛（象矛）、牛皮盾與圓頭棍棒，另有經納塔爾港貿易得來的滑膛燧發步槍與口徑較大的來復槍，但比例遠低於矛盾。
kitsEn: The matchlock on this card had long since left the field, and what it left behind in the system was the idea of the volley. The sixteenth-century Spanish square produced its ordered volleys by firing the matchlocks rank by rank, buying rate of fire with thickness; by the nineteenth century the square had given way to line and skirmish, and the matchlock itself had been displaced by the flintlock, so that neither army at the Blood River carried one, and the matchlocks in the stores were nothing but relics of an earlier age. What actually fought were the old Boer guns: mostly smoothbore flintlock muskets of Dutch and British pattern, a fair number of flintlock rifles, and a few already converted to percussion, with short-barrelled flintlock pistols the standard equipment of officers and wagon commanders. The Boers had only two guns: a six-pounder naval carronade brought from the Cape, named Grietjie and mounted on a carriage improvised from a wagon axle, and a second piece of unknown type usually depicted as an obsolete four-pounder smoothbore, both firing canister and round shot and both used for close targets. The ox wagons were the heavier equipment of the battle: sixty-four of them drawn into a ring to make a breastwork, with movable wooden barriers and ladders fixed between the wheels, and they carried the ammunition and the food as well. The Zulu equipment was cold weapons for the most part: the short stabbing spears introduced by Shaka, cowhide shields and knobbed clubs, together with smoothbore flintlock muskets and larger calibre rifles bought through the trade at Port Natal, but in a proportion far below the spears and shields.
tactics: 這一戰的戰術核心是「選地」與「車陣」。普雷托里烏斯在十二月初連續行軍，於十二月十五日讓車隊渡過布拉法河，距烏姆貢貢德洛夫仍有八十公里，他沒有進攻，反而在納孔河北岸選了一處北面是縱深八米的河馬潭壁、下方即水面、對面開闊無遮蔽的陣地，把六十四輛牛車拉成圓陣，車隊形成兩面受保護、正面暴露的形勢，兩門砲架在車陣的角上，車隊在夜間把燈籠掛在象鞭上，使營地在夜色中像一圈火環。前一晚恩德勒拉屬下的六個團約兩萬人渡過納孔河，在營地周邊集結，精銳留河北岸，達姆布扎的團在晨光中逼近。祖魯軍以牛角陣展開，左右兩翼成叉形包抄，左翼利用晨霧掩蔽接近；祖魯方面的說法是左角先與敵接觸，過河的人受火後退到恩德勒拉山。十六日清晨天氣晴朗，守軍出營迎戰，布爾人以火槍齊射與霰彈招呼攻擊者，車隊的柵欄擋住接近，祖魯人一次次躍過殘骸衝上車牆，四波衝鋒在兩小時四分鐘內反覆而來，間歇正是布爾人裝填與喘息的空隙。兩小時後，普雷托里烏斯擔心彈藥耗盡，下令打開車門放出騎兵作快速衝擊，試圖誘使祖魯陣形崩潰，祖魯人一度抵抗，隨即因損失慘重而四散，布爾人追擊三小時。
tacticsEn: The tactical heart of the battle was the choice of ground and the wagon laager. After marching in the first days of December, Pretorius had the wagons cross the Buffalo River on 15 December, still eighty kilometres from UmGungundlovu, and instead of attacking he chose a position on the north bank of the Ncome where an eight-metre drop into a deep hippo pool protected two sides and the open ground in front gave the attacker no cover at all. The sixty-four ox wagons were drawn into a ring, giving a position covered on two flanks and open in front, with the two guns at the corners of the ring and lanterns hung on sjamboks around the camp so that it looked like a ring of fire in the night. On the night of 15 December six regiments of about twenty thousand men under Ndlela crossed the Ncome and massed around the camp, the elite held back on the far bank, and Dambuza's regiments closed in at first light. The Zulu deployed in ox-horn formation, the two wings opening out like a fork, the left horn using the morning mist to screen its approach; in the Zulu telling the left horn was the only wing in contact, and those who crossed were driven back by the fire to Ndlela's mountain. The morning of the 16th was clear. The Boers met the attack with musket volleys and canister from behind the wagon barricades, and the Zulus leapt the dead again and again to the wagon wall. Four waves came on over two hours and four minutes, the lulls between them being the only time the Boers had to reload and rest. After two hours Pretorius, fearful of his ammunition running low, opened the gates and sent out mounted men to strike fast and break the Zulu order; the Zulus held on for a time and then scattered under their losses, and the Boers hunted them down for three hours.
data: 可核對的數字大致如下。戰役發生於一八三八年十二月十六日星期日。布爾人一方的常見說法是四百六十四名武裝者，另有服務人員一百名至二百名，另一說只有五十九人；隨行牛車六十四輛，砲兩門，其中一門為六磅海軍短管砲「小格雷特姬」。祖魯一方的估算差距極大，一般引用的說法是兩萬五千至三萬人；當夜渡過納孔河者被記為六個團約兩萬人，班切斯在日誌中記下一名俘虜的說法，稱共有三十六個團、每團九百至一千人。戰果方面，班切斯記錄約三千名祖魯人陣亡，含兩位王子；布爾人方面僅三人受傷，普雷托里烏斯本人的左手被矛刺傷。地點與行程方面，車隊在十二月十五日渡過布拉法河，距離烏姆貢貢德洛夫約八十公里，營地距義大利尼隘口尚有四十公里，納孔河因連日大雨水漲，渡河困難；戰鬥自清晨持續約兩小時四分鐘，隨後追擊三小時。前因方面，一八三八年二月六日雷蒂夫一行在王營遇害，十日後又有多處移民營寨遭夜襲；戰後四天車隊抵達焚毀的王營，十一月恩德勒拉被絞死，一八四〇年一月曼康蓋一役盟軍獲勝，一八四一年比勒馬里茨堡建起「許願教堂」，一九四七與一九七二年先後立起花崗岩與青銅車陣紀念碑。
dataEn: The figures that can be checked run roughly as follows. The battle was fought on Sunday 16 December 1838. The Boer side is usually given as four hundred and sixty-four armed men, with between one hundred and two hundred servants, another account counting only fifty-nine; sixty-four ox wagons and two guns went with them, one of them the six-pounder naval carronade Grietjie. Estimates for the Zulu force vary enormously, the figure most often cited being twenty-five to thirty thousand; the men who crossed the Ncome on the night of 15 December are given as six regiments of about twenty thousand, and Bantjes recorded a prisoner's claim of thirty-six regiments of nine hundred to a thousand men each. On the results, Bantjes counted about three thousand Zulu dead, two of them princes, while only three Boers were wounded, Pretorius himself being struck in the left hand by a spear. On ground and movement: the wagons crossed the Buffalo River on 15 December, some eighty kilometres from UmGungundlovu; the campsite lay forty kilometres short of the Italeni defile; the Ncome was swollen after heavy rain and hard to cross. The fighting lasted about two hours and four minutes from first light, followed by three hours of pursuit. On the antecedents, Retief and his party were killed at the royal kraal on 6 February 1838 and several trekker camps were attacked by night ten days later; four days after the battle the commando reached the burnt kraal, Ndlela was strangled in November, Mpande's forces won at Maqongqe in January 1840, the Church of the Vow was built at Pietermaritzburg in 1841, and granite and bronze wagon laagers were raised as monuments in 1947 and 1972.
cause: 打起來的原因是土地、牛群與王位三件事疊在一起。一八三七年起，布爾人移民在納特利亞一帶向祖魯人租地放牧，協議屢次被丁干撕毀；皮埃特·雷蒂夫受移民推舉，一八三八年二月三日與丁干在烏姆貢貢德洛夫簽訂土地協議，條件是取回約七百頭被托克瓦人偷走的牛，並取得通往納塔爾港的通行權。丁干交涉時提出的另一項要求，是入境者必須交出火槍，這在布爾人眼中是無恥的侮辱。丁干真正擔心的是形勢：曼潘德是唯一有子嗣的王子，先鋒首領的實力在一天天增長，恩德勒拉的直屬武裝才是他唯一能倚重的力量。二月六日，王營以「殺死巫師」為由殺害雷蒂夫一行，隨後派「因皮」夜襲多處移民營寨，邊境不再有秩序可言。布爾人一方的選擇是報復而非談判：他們在四月、九月的兩次攻勢中分別在義大利尼狹谷與弗格拉爾的車陣前失利，亨德里克·波特吉特一類的首領因此心灰意冷離開納特利亞，十一月，安德烈斯·普雷托里烏斯接手，決定把主動權拿回來。他不走恩德勒拉設下的隘口伏擊路線，而是選擇自己的戰場，把「把祖魯人引到我的陣地上打我」作為唯一目標。
causeEn: The causes were land, cattle and the succession, tangled together. From 1837 the Voortrekkers rented grazing in Natal on terms that Dingane repeatedly tore up. Chosen by the trekkers to represent them, Piet Retief signed a land settlement with Dingane at UmGungundlovu on 3 February 1838, on condition of recovering roughly seven hundred head of cattle taken by the Tlokwa and of being given access to Port Natal. The further condition Dingane imposed was that the visitors surrender their muskets on entering, which the Boers took as a shameful insult. What really worried Dingane was the state of the kingdom: Mpande was the only prince with issue and the strength of the Boer commandos was growing, and Ndlela's own armed following was the only force on which the king could rely. On 6 February the kraal, crying that the visitors were wizards, killed Retief and his party, and impi regiments were then sent by night against several trekker camps; after that there was no order on the frontier. The Boers chose revenge rather than negotiation: their offensives of April and November broke at the Italeni defile and before the wagon laager at Veglaer, and leaders such as Hendrik Potgieter left Natal in discouragement. In November Andries Pretorius took over and resolved to seize the initiative. He refused the route Ndlela had laid for him and chose his own ground, with one object: to draw the Zulus onto a position of his own choosing and fight them there.
impact: 後果分成祖魯與布爾人兩條線。祖魯方面，丁干的王權被重創，兩位王子的死亡與數千人的損失使恩德勒拉的權力中樞崩塌，普雷托里烏斯在比勒馬里茨堡主持曼潘德的加冕儀式，兩家以塔格拉河為界劃定邊界，納特利亞共和國於一八三九年成立並定都比勒馬里茨堡；此後丁干仍支持了一年，其部下在白翁福洛西一役重創布爾人，說明一場血河不足以終結戰爭，一八四〇年一月曼康蓋一役後丁干才被迫出逃，恩德勒拉被以牛皮慢慢絞死。布爾人方面，這一天後來被神化：一八三八年十二月十六日被定為「許願日」，一八四一年在比勒馬里茨堡建起「許願教堂」，一九四九年血河紀念碑落成，成為南非白人國家主義的聖地，歷史學家麥考爾·西亞爾的詮釋把此役解釋為神的干預與民族天授權；相對地，一九九八年祖魯方面在納孔河東岸另立紀念碑，以和解之名紀念陣亡者，兩種紀念在同一片河岸對立至今。一八七九年的英祖戰爭則是這場戰役最遙遠的迴響，祖魯王國在尚武精神上承自丁干時代，而其軍事制度在血河之後已走上與英國現代槍砲正面對撞的老路。
impactEn: The consequences ran along two separate lines. For the Zulus, Dingane's royal power was broken: two princes dead and several thousand men lost, the inner ring of Ndlela's authority collapsed, Pretorius presided over the coronation of Mpande at Pietermaritzburg, and the two houses drew a border along the Tugela River, with the Natalia Republic founded in 1839 and its capital at Pietermaritzburg. Dingane nevertheless held out for another year, and his men gave the Boers a severe reverse at the White Umfolozi, which showed that the Blood River did not end the war; only after Maqongqe in January 1840 did Dingane flee and Ndlela was slowly strangled with cowhide. For the Boers, the day was afterwards made sacred: 16 December 1838 was set aside as the Day of the Vow, the Church of the Vow was built at Pietermaritzburg in 1841, and the Voortrekker Monument was unveiled in 1949, becoming a holy place of Afrikaner nationalism, in which the interpretations of sympathetic historians such as George McCall Theal read the victory as divine intervention and a divinely given right to exist as a people. On the other side, a monument and museum complex was raised on the east bank of the Ncome in 1998, where the dead of the Zulu were commemorated under the language of reconciliation, and the two memories still face each other across the same river. The Anglo-Zulu War of 1879 was the most distant echo of it, the martial culture of the Zulu kingdom descending directly from Dingane's time, while its military system had by then taken the road that led to a direct collision with British rifles and artillery.
result: 結果是決定性的布爾人勝利。十二個月的血戰在一天之內解決：牛車陣與火槍齊射擋住四波牛角陣的衝擊，祖魯軍留下約三千具屍體，兩位爭位王子陣亡，恩德勒拉的精銳隔河未戰而士氣盡失；四天後車隊抵達烏姆貢貢德洛夫，王營已焚成焦土，雷蒂夫的遺骸被尋獲安葬，通行納塔爾港的權利因而成為現實。布爾人付出的代價極小，三人受傷，其中一人是總指揮普雷托里烏斯。但勝利並不等於結束：十一天後祖魯人在白翁福洛西反敗為勝，殺傷跟隨的布爾人，一八四〇年一月曼康蓋一役再敗，丁干逃離納特利亞，恩德勒拉因通敵被絞死，曼潘德在比勒馬里茨堡加冕，兩家以塔格里亞河為界。於是這場戰爭的最終結果是：布爾人用車陣與火槍贏得了一個國家，祖魯人失去一位國王與兩位王子，但也保住了王位繼承權，而血河這一天本身此後被兩種歷史敘述分別收編，成為南非政治記憶中最不肯退讓的一塊。
resultEn: The result was a decisive Boer victory. Twelve months of war were settled in a single day: the wagon laager and the musket volleys stopped four assaults of the ox-horn, the Zulu left about three thousand dead, two princes competing for the throne were among them, and Ndlela's elite, which had not crossed the river, lost heart without a blow. Four days later the commando reached UmGungundlovu and found the kraal burnt to the ground, Retief's remains were found and buried, and access to Port Natal became a reality. The Boers paid very little: three wounded, one of them the commander Pretorius. But victory was not the end. Eleven days later the Zulus won at the White Umfolozi and cut down the Boers who followed them; after the defeat at Maqongqe in January 1840 Dingane was driven out of Natal, Ndlela was strangled for his treachery, Mpande was crowned at Pietermaritzburg, and the Tugela River became the border. So the final result of the war was this: the Boers won a country with a wagon laager and muskets; the Zulus lost a king and two princes but kept the succession; and the day at the Blood River itself was afterwards annexed by two rival historical narratives, becoming the most stubbornly contested piece of political memory in South Africa.
